file_change.purpose: Represent Core Planning-owned normative requirements, Conformance/Assurance applicability, stable authority identities, explicit delegation, and minimal default-deny authorization.
implementation: Define immutable NormativeRequirement records with stable ID, one normative statement, Conformance disposition, and Assurance disposition.
Validate requirement IDs, uniqueness, applicability values, and required rationale for an explicit none disposition.
Enforce only the mechanically necessary Core normative-force grammar: explicit normative force using accepted SHALL, SHALL NOT, or MAY vocabulary.
Represent stable framework authority identities and explicit delegation edges without inferring authority from implementation or historical state.
Provide default-deny authorization lookup for governed Core state; absence of accepted authority or an explicitly governed extension point is rejection rather than inferred permission.
Defer semantic normative-statement quality, generalized normative lifecycle history, derived/product provenance hardening, and mature validation correspondence to later functional sets.
